name: Game Graveyard Zone
description: Links graveyards (world_safe_locs) to areas/zones or whole maps: when a player dies, the closest graveyard linked to their area (then zone, then map) and usable by their team is chosen.

fields.name: Safe Loc
fields.help: Open the graveyard world safe location.

fields.name: Ghost Loc
fields.help: Area or zone id the dead player is in when Link Kind is area link; a map id when Link Kind is map link.

fields.name: Link Kind
fields.help: 0 = Ghost Loc is an area/zone id, 1 = Ghost Loc is a map id.

fields.name: Team
fields.help: Team allowed to use this graveyard link: 0 = both, 67 = horde, 469 = alliance.
